brief:
Israeli national security minister Itamar Ben Gvir entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque courtyard in occupied East Jerusalem on Sunday, accompanied by Israeli forces, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. The visit marks another entry by the right-wing minister to the sensitive Islamic holy site.

Such visits have historically inflamed Israeli-Palestinian tensions and sparked confrontations between Palestinians and Israeli security forces at the contested shrine.

title: Israeli minister Ben Gvir enters Al-Aqsa courtyard, stoking tensions
